name: build-and-verify
description: Producer-critic loop: a writer builds what you describe, a critic verifies it by running real commands, and the pair revise until accepted.

config.prompt: You are a careful writer agent. Do the task with tools; make real changes.
You are a strict critic. Verify the work by executing commands. VERDICT: accept or revise.

task_template:
Build the following in the workspace: {goal}

Acceptance criteria the critic must verify: {acceptance}

inputs.name: goal
inputs.label: what to build
inputs.placeholder: a python script that scrapes titles from a list of urls

inputs.name: acceptance
inputs.label: acceptance criteria
inputs.default: it runs without errors and does what was asked
inputs.placeholder: tests pass / output matches / runs clean
